title: Prakrama 4, Sarga 19. The Kirtana of Gauranga Performed by Sri Advaita Prabhu
html:
In Kashi Mishra's house the Lord and His devotees partake of Jagannatha's prasada, and He Himself feeds them; the devotees are lodged in houses, their wives cook for the Lord, and Advaita feeds Him in private; Advaita begins a new kirtana of Gaurachandra's names, and all dance in ecstasy

Verse 1

ततो भक्तगणैः सार्धं नित्यानन्दधृतः प्रभुः।
काशीनाथगृहं शीघ्रमागतो जगदीश्वरः॥१॥

tato bhaktagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṁ nityānandadhṛtaḥ prabhuḥ|
kāśīnāthagṛhaṁ śīghramāgato jagadīśvaraḥ||1||

tatah — then; bhakta-ganaih sardham — together with the devotees; nityananda-dhritah — supported by Nityananda; prabhuh — the Lord; kashinatha-griham — to the house of Kashinatha; shighram — quickly; agatah — came; jagat-ishvarah — the Lord of the world.

1Then the Lord, the Lord of the world, leaning on Nityananda, soon came with the devotees to the house of Kashinatha1.

Verse 2

जगन्नाथप्रसादान्नं नित्यानन्दसमन्वितः।
श्रीलाद्वैतादिभिः सार्धं स्वरूपाद्यैर्निवेदितम्॥२॥

jagannāthaprasādānnaṁ nityānandasamanvitaḥ|
śrīlādvaitādibhiḥ sārdhaṁ svarūpādyairniveditam||2||

jagannatha-prasada-annam — the food that is Jagannatha's prasada; nityananda-samanvitah — together with Nityananda; shrila-advaita-adibhih sardham — together with Srila Advaita and the others; svarupa-adyaih — by Svarupa and the others; niveditam — offered.

2Together with Nityananda, Srila Advaita and the others He partook of Jagannatha's prasada, offered by Svarupa and the others —

Verse 3

भुक्त्वा चतुर्विधं द्रव्यं भक्तसंकल्पपालकः।
भोजयामास स्वान् भक्तान् पुत्रप्रायेण लालयन्॥३॥

bhuktvā caturvidhaṁ dravyaṁ bhaktasaṁkalpapālakaḥ|
bhojayāmāsa svān bhaktān putraprāyeṇa lālayan||3||

bhuktva — having partaken of; chatur-vidham — of four kinds; dravyam — the foods; bhakta-sankalpa-palakah — who fulfils His devotees' desires; bhojayam asa — fed; svan — His own; bhaktan — devotees; putra-prayena — as if they were His sons; lalayan — fondling.

3foods of four kinds2 — and then He who fulfils His devotees' desires began to feed His own devotees, fondling them as if they were His sons.

Verse 4

त्वं भुङ्क्ष भुङ्क्ष भुङ्क्षेति वात्सल्यरसमूर्तिमान्।
जगदानन्दस्वरूपाद्यान् हरिरेव दयानिधिः॥४॥

tvaṁ bhuṅkṣa bhuṅkṣa bhuṅkṣeti vātsalyarasamūrtimān|
jagadānandasvarūpādyān harireva dayānidhiḥ||4||

tvam — you; bhunkshva bhunkshva bhunkshva — eat, eat, eat; iti — thus (saying); vatsalya-rasa-murtiman — the rasa of parental love embodied; jagadananda-svarupa-adyan — to Jagadananda, Svarupa and the others; harih — Hari; eva — indeed; daya-nidhih — the treasury of mercy.

4"Eat, eat, eat!" said Hari, the treasury of mercy, the rasa of parental love embodied, to Jagadananda, Svarupa and the others.

Verse 5

एवं क्रमेण प्रत्यक्षं संबोध्य कौशलान्वितः।
संभोज्य भूरिद्रव्येण चातुर्विध्येन वैष्णवान्॥५॥

evaṁ krameṇa pratyakṣaṁ saṁbodhya kauśalānvitaḥ|
saṁbhojya bhūridravyeṇa cāturvidhyena vaiṣṇavān||5||

evam — thus; kramena — in turn; pratyaksham — in person; sambodhya — addressing; kaushala-anvitah — with skill; sambhojya — having fed; bhuri-dravyena — with abundant foods; chatur-vidhyena — of four kinds; vaishnavan — the Vaishnavas.

5Thus, skilfully addressing each in turn, and having fed the Vaishnavas with abundant foods of four kinds,

Verse 6

गण्डूषादिक्रियाः सर्वं समाप्य जगदीश्वरः।
चन्दनपुष्पमालाभ्यां भूषयित्वा यथाक्रमम्॥६॥

gaṇḍūṣādikriyāḥ sarvaṁ samāpya jagadīśvaraḥ|
candanapuṣpamālābhyāṁ bhūṣayitvā yathākramam||6||

gandusha-adi-kriyah — the rinsing of the mouth and other rites; sarvam — all; samapya — having completed; jagat-ishvarah — the Lord of the world; chandana-pushpa-malabhyam — with sandal paste and flower garlands; bhushayitva — having adorned; yatha-kramam — in due order.

6the Lord of the world, when the rinsing of the mouth and other rites were completed, adorned them in due order with sandal paste and flower garlands.

Verse 7

नित्यानन्दाद्वैतमुख्यान् भक्तान् गौडनिवासिनः।
उत्कलस्थानपि श्वेतद्वीपस्थान् वैष्णवान् प्रभुः॥७॥

nityānandādvaitamukhyān bhaktān gauḍanivāsinaḥ|
utkalasthānapi śvetadvīpasthān vaiṣṇavān prabhuḥ||7||

nityananda-advaita-mukhyan — headed by Nityananda and Advaita; bhaktan — the devotees; gauda-nivasinah — dwelling in Gauda; utkala-sthan — dwelling in Utkala; api — and; shvetadvipa-sthan — abiding in Shvetadvipa; vaishnavan — the Vaishnavas; prabhuh — the Lord.

7The devotees of Gauda headed by Nityananda and Advaita, and also the Vaishnavas living in Utkala and in Shvetadvipa3 —

Verse 8

लालयामास करुणो वात्सल्याद्भक्तवत्सलः।
तैः समं सुखमासीनः संकीर्तनकुतूहली॥८॥

lālayāmāsa karuṇo vātsalyādbhaktavatsalaḥ|
taiḥ samaṁ sukhamāsīnaḥ saṁkīrtanakutūhalī||8||

lalayam asa — cherished; karunah — compassionate; vatsalyat — out of parental love; bhakta-vatsalah — loving to His devotees; taih samam — together with them; sukham — happily; asinah — sitting; sankirtana-kutuhali — eager for sankirtana.

8all of them the compassionate Lord, who loves His devotees, cherished with a parent's tenderness, and then He sat happily among them, eager for sankirtana.

Verse 9

राजाज्ञया महापात्रश्चन्दनेश्वरसंज्ञकः।
भक्तान् निवासयामास गेहे गेहे यथासुखम्॥९॥

rājājñayā mahāpātraścandaneśvarasaṁjñakaḥ|
bhaktān nivāsayāmāsa gehe gehe yathāsukham||9||

raja-ajnaya — by the king's order; maha-patrah — the mahapatra (minister); chandaneshvara-samjnakah — named Chandaneshvara; bhaktan — the devotees; nivasayam asa — lodged; gehe gehe — in various houses; yatha-sukham — comfortably.

9By the king's order the mahapatra4 named Chandaneshvara lodged the devotees comfortably in various houses.

Verse 10

एवं भक्तगणाः सर्वे संकीर्तनपरायणाः।
तिष्ठन्ति प्रभुणा सार्धं संकीर्तनविनोदिना॥१०॥

evaṁ bhaktagaṇāḥ sarve saṁkīrtanaparāyaṇāḥ|
tiṣṭhanti prabhuṇā sārdhaṁ saṁkīrtanavinodinā||10||

evam — thus; bhakta-ganah — the devotees; sarve — all; sankirtana-parayanah — devoted to sankirtana; tishthanti — stay; prabhuna sardham — with the Lord; sankirtana-vinodina — who delights in sankirtana.

10Thus all the devotees, given to sankirtana, stayed with the Lord, who delights in sankirtana.

Verse 11

प्रभुप्रीतये यद्द्रव्यं तैरानीतं प्रयत्नतः।
तेन वैष्णवपत्नीभिः पाचितं परमादरात्॥११॥

prabhuprītaye yaddravyaṁ tairānītaṁ prayatnataḥ|
tena vaiṣṇavapatnībhiḥ pācitaṁ paramādarāt||11||

prabhu-pritaye — for the Lord's pleasure; yat — what; dravyam — provisions; taih — by them; anitam — were brought; prayatnatah — with care; tena — from them; vaishnava-patnibhih — by the Vaishnavas' wives; pachitam — was cooked; parama-adarat — with the greatest reverence.

11From the provisions they had carefully brought for the Lord's pleasure, the Vaishnavas' wives cooked with the greatest reverence a meal

Verse 12

अन्नं चतुर्विधेनापि रसेन सहितं प्रभुः।
बुभुजे च घृतैः सिक्तं सभक्तः साग्रजः सुखी॥१२॥

annaṁ caturvidhenāpi rasena sahitaṁ prabhuḥ|
bubhuje ca ghṛtaiḥ siktaṁ sabhaktaḥ sāgrajaḥ sukhī||12||

annam — the food; chatur-vidhena — of four kinds; api — and; rasena — with flavours; sahitam — endowed; prabhuh — the Lord; bubhuje — ate; cha — and; ghritaih — with ghee; siktam — sprinkled; sa-bhaktah — with His devotees; sa-agrajah — with His elder brother; sukhi — happy.

12of four kinds of flavours, sprinkled with ghee; and the Lord, with His devotees and His elder brother, happily ate it.

Verse 13

अद्वैतो भगवान् साक्षात् स्वयमोदनमुत्तमम्।
पक्त्वा सुमधुरं चापि नीत्वा तं भार्यया सह॥१३॥

advaito bhagavān sākṣāt svayamodanamuttamam|
paktvā sumadhuraṁ cāpi nītvā taṁ bhāryayā saha||13||

advaitah — Advaita; bhagavan — divine; sakshat — in person; svayam — himself; odanam — rice; uttamam — excellent; paktva — having cooked; su-madhuram — most sweet; cha api — and; nitva — bringing; tam — it; bharyaya saha — together with his wife.

13Divine Advaita Himself cooked excellent, most sweet rice and, bringing it with His wife,

Verse 14

निभृतं भोजयामास क्षीरं घृतसमन्वितम्।
स्वप्राणवल्लभं कृष्णचैतन्यं भक्तवत्सलम्॥१४॥

nibhṛtaṁ bhojayāmāsa kṣīraṁ ghṛtasamanvitam|
svaprāṇavallabhaṁ kṛṣṇacaitanyaṁ bhaktavatsalam||14||

nibhritam — in private; bhojayam asa — fed; kshiram — milk-rice; ghrita-samanvitam — with ghee; sva-prana-vallabham — dear as his own life; krishna-chaitanyam — Krishna Chaitanya; bhakta-vatsalam — loving to His devotees.

14fed in private milk-rice with ghee to Krishna Chaitanya, who loves His devotees, dear to Him as His own life.

Verse 15

एवं क्रमेण श्रीवासपण्डिताद्याः सपत्नीकाः।
सेवां चक्रुर्भगवतो गौराङ्गस्य यथासुखम्॥१५॥

evaṁ krameṇa śrīvāsapaṇḍitādyāḥ sapatnīkāḥ|
sevāṁ cakrurbhagavato gaurāṅgasya yathāsukham||15||

evam — thus; kramena — in turn; shrivasa-pandita-adyah — Srivasa Pandita and the others; sa-patnikah — with their wives; sevam — service; chakruh — rendered; bhagavatah — to the Lord; gaurangasya — to Gauranga; yatha-sukham — to their heart's content.

15Thus in turn Srivasa Pandita and the others, with their wives, served the Lord, Gauranga, to their heart's content.

Verse 16

ततश्चाद्वैतगोस्वामी संमन्त्र्य स्वजनैः सह।
नवीनं गौरचन्द्रस्य नामसंकीर्तनं शुभम्॥१६॥

tataścādvaitagosvāmī saṁmantrya svajanaiḥ saha|
navīnaṁ gauracandrasya nāmasaṁkīrtanaṁ śubham||16||

tatah cha — and then; advaita-gosvami — Advaita Gosvami; samantrya — having taken counsel; sva-janaih saha — with his own people; navinam — a new; gaurachandrasya — of Gaurachandra; nama-sankirtanam — sankirtana of the names; shubham — auspicious.

16And then Advaita Gosvami, having taken counsel with His own people, begins a new and auspicious sankirtana of Gaurachandra's names.

Verse 17

करोति मण्डलीकृत्य हर्षेण वैष्णवैः सह।
नृत्यति परमोद्दण्डं गर्जति धावति क्वचित्॥१७॥

karoti maṇḍalīkṛtya harṣeṇa vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha|
nṛtyati paramoddaṇḍaṁ garjati dhāvati kvacit||17||

karoti — performs; mandali-kritya — forming a circle; harshena — joyfully; vaishnavaih saha — with the Vaishnavas; nrityati — dances; parama-uddandam — wildly, leaping high; garjati — roars; dhavati — runs; kvachit — at times.

17Forming a circle with the Vaishnavas, He rejoices, dances wildly, leaping high, roars, and at times runs about.

Verse 18

नित्यानन्दोऽपि भगवान् गौराङ्गभावभावितः।
यस्य नृत्यपदाघातैः कम्पते भुवनत्रयम्॥१८॥

nityānando'pi bhagavān gaurāṅgabhāvabhāvitaḥ|
yasya nṛtyapadāghātaiḥ kampate bhuvanatrayam||18||

nityanandah — Nityananda; api — too; bhagavan — the Lord; gauranga-bhava-bhavitah — imbued with love for Gauranga; yasya — whose; nritya-pada-aghataih — by the stamping of feet in dance; kampate — trembles; bhuvana-trayam — the three worlds.

18Lord Nityananda too dances, imbued with love for Gauranga — at the stamping of His feet in the dance the three worlds tremble.

Verse 19

मत्प्राणसर्वस्वगौरचन्द्र मामुद्धर प्रभो।
नित्यानन्दप्रिय गौर गदाधररसप्रद॥१९॥

matprāṇasarvasvagauracandra māmuddhara prabho|
nityānandapriya gaura gadādhararasaprada||19||

mat-prana-sarvasva-gaurachandra — O Gaurachandra, my life and all; mam — me; uddhara — deliver; prabho — O Lord; nityananda-priya — O beloved of Nityananda; gaura — O Gaura; gadadhara-rasa-prada — who give rasa to Gadadhara.

19"O Gaurachandra, my life and all, deliver me, O Lord! O beloved of Nityananda, Gaura, who give rasa to Gadadhara!

Verse 20

श्रीवासादिप्रियप्राण प्रेमद करुणार्णव।
एवं संकीर्तनं सोऽपि गौराङ्गः कीर्तनप्रियः॥२०॥

śrīvāsādipriyaprāṇa premada karuṇārṇava|
evaṁ saṁkīrtanaṁ so'pi gaurāṅgaḥ kīrtanapriyaḥ||20||

shrivasa-adi-priya-prana — O You who are dear as life to Srivasa and the others; prema-da — O giver of love; karuna-arnava — O ocean of compassion; evam — such; sankirtanam — sankirtana; sah — He; api — too; gaurangah — Gauranga; kirtana-priyah — who loves kirtana.

20O You who are dear as life to Srivasa and the others, giver of love, ocean of compassion!" Such sankirtana Gauranga Himself, who loves kirtana,

Verse 21

कृष्णसंकीर्तनं मत्वा जगौ प्रेमवशः स्वयम्।
स एव कीर्तनानन्दो ब्रह्माण्डं पूरयन् बभौ॥२१॥

kṛṣṇasaṁkīrtanaṁ matvā jagau premavaśaḥ svayam|
sa eva kīrtanānando brahmāṇḍaṁ pūrayan babhau||21||

krishna-sankirtanam — as sankirtana of Krishna; matva — considering; jagau — sang; prema-vashah — overpowered by love; svayam — Himself; sah — that; eva — very; kirtana-anandah — bliss of kirtana; brahmandam — the universe; purayan — filling; babhau — shone forth.

21took to be the sankirtana of Krishna, and overpowered by love He sang; and the bliss of that kirtana shone forth, filling the whole universe.

Verse 22

सर्वे पश्यन्ति नृत्यन्तं गौरचन्द्रं स्वसम्मुखम्।
यथा मध्यगतं कृष्णं बालका वनभोजिनः॥२२॥

sarve paśyanti nṛtyantaṁ gauracandraṁ svasammukham|
yathā madhyagataṁ kṛṣṇaṁ bālakā vanabhojinaḥ||22||

sarve — all; pashyanti — see; nrityantam — dancing; gaurachandram — Gaurachandra; sva-sammukham — facing themselves; yatha — as; madhya-gatam — in the middle; krishnam — Krishna; balakah — the boys; vana-bhojinah — who feasted in the forest.

22Each one sees Gaurachandra dancing right before him, as the boys who feasted in the forest saw Krishna in their midst5.

Verse 23

ईश्वरोऽपि भगवताद्वैताचार्येण संयुतः।
नित्यानन्दो महातेजाः प्रेमोन्मादेन नृत्यति॥२३॥

īśvaro'pi bhagavatādvaitācāryeṇa saṁyutaḥ|
nityānando mahātejāḥ premonmādena nṛtyati||23||

ishvarah — the Lord; api — though; bhagavata — with the divine; advaita-acharyena — Advaita Acharya; samyutah — together; nityanandah — Nityananda; maha-tejah — of great power; prema-unmadena — in the madness of love; nrityati — dances.

23And though He is the Lord Himself, Nityananda, great in power, dances in the madness of love together with divine Advaita Acharya.

Verse 24

मत्तपारीन्द्रविक्रान्तः कारयन्नवनीतलम्।
गौराङ्गप्रेमदाता यस्तस्य किं चित्रमेव तत्॥२४॥

mattapārīndravikrāntaḥ kārayannavanītalam|
gaurāṅgapremadātā yastasya kiṁ citrameva tat||24||

matta-parindra-vikrantah — striding like a maddened lion; karayan — setting in motion; avani-talam — the surface of the earth; gauranga-prema-data — the giver of love for Gauranga; yah — who; tasya — for him; kim — what; chitram — wonder; eva — indeed; tat — that.

24He strides like a maddened lion, as if setting the very earth in motion6 — but He is the giver of love for Gauranga: what wonder is there in that?

Verse 25

गदाधरोऽपि गौराङ्गप्रीतिदो नृत्यति सुखम्।
श्रीवासाद्याः सुखं सर्वे नृत्यन्ति गौरचेतसः॥२५॥

gadādharo'pi gaurāṅgaprītido nṛtyati sukham|
śrīvāsādyāḥ sukhaṁ sarve nṛtyanti gauracetasaḥ||25||

gadadharah — Gadadhara; api — too; gauranga-priti-dah — who gives joy to Gauranga; nrityati — dances; sukham — blissfully; shrivasa-adyah — Srivasa and the others; sukham — blissfully; sarve — all; nrityanti — dance; gaura-chetasah — whose hearts are given to Gaura.

25Gadadhara too, who gives joy to Gauranga, dances in bliss; and all the others headed by Srivasa, whose hearts are given to Gaura, dance blissfully.

Verse 26

एतदन्तर्गतं यस्य गौराङ्गगुणकीर्तनम्।
स एव साक्षी नान्ये च कोटिशो ज्ञानपारगाः॥२६॥

etadantargataṁ yasya gaurāṅgaguṇakīrtanam|
sa eva sākṣī nānye ca koṭiśo jñānapāragāḥ||26||

etat — this; antargatam — has entered within; yasya — whose (heart); gauranga-guna-kirtanam — kirtana of Gauranga's qualities; sah — he; eva — alone; sakshi — is witness; na — not; anye — others; cha — but; kotishah — by millions; jnana-paragah — who have reached the far shore of knowledge.

26Only one into whose heart this kirtana of Gauranga's qualities has entered can bear witness to it — not others, though they be millions and have reached the far shore of knowledge.

Thus ends the nineteenth sarga, "The Kirtana of Gauranga Performed by Sri Advaita Prabhu" (Shrimad-advaita-prabhu-kritam shri-gauranga-kirtanam), of the fourth prakrama of the poem "Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita."

✦

Notes

  1. Kashinatha is Kashi Mishra, in whose house at Puri the Lord lived.
  2. The four kinds of food: what is chewed, sucked, licked and drunk.
  3. Shvetadvipa ("the White Island") is the Lord's abode in the Ocean of Milk; what is meant here (celestial Vaishnavas or some locality) is unclear; in later Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition Navadvipa too is called Shvetadvipa.
  4. Mahapatra: the title of a high official at the court of the king of Orissa.
  5. Cf. Bhagavata Purana 10.13.8: at the forest meal each of the cowherd boys saw Krishna facing him.
  6. The reading of this passage is unclear; the translation is conjectural.
